Sure! Let me provide you with more details about the Coffee Club membership program. By joining the Coffee Club, you can enjoy the following benefits:

1. **Free Shipping**: Get free standard shipping on all orders over $200.
2. **Early Access**: Receive early access to new product lines and limited-time offers.
3. **Member Discounts**: Enjoy special member discounts every month on select items.
4. **Extended Warranty**: Get an extended 19-month warranty on select products.
5. **Coffee Bean Subscription**: Stay up-to-date with our monthly coffee bean subscription program.

There are three membership tiers to choose from, each offering different benefits based on your level of loyalty. Let me know if you'd like more information on the specific tiers and how to sign up!
